questions.question:

Doctor ∶ Diagnosis ∶∶ Painter ∶ Painting ∶∶ Judge ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**The second word is the work of the professional which is mentioned in the first word.**

Doctor ∶ Diagnosis → A Doctor does diagnosis.

Painter ∶ Painting → A Painter does painting.

Similarly,

**Judge ∶ ? **→ A Judge gives **Judgement**.

Hence,** option 1)** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All P's are M.

II. Some Q's are P.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some M's are Q.

II. Some P's are Q.

III. Some M's are P.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follow.
Conclusions I, II and III follow.

questions.solution:
Statements:

I. All P's are M.

II. Some Q's are P.

__Venn diagram:__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a096d6d71c997ee159d20950b6d0add86a1d899320c301ce33eb536ed9fd498e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some M's are Q. → Follows (because some Q's are P and all P's are M, so some M's are definitely Q.)

II. Some P's are Q. → Follows (because it is given that some Q's are P, so definitely some P's are Q too.)

III. Some M's are P. → Follows (because it is given that all P's are M, so some M's are definitely P.)

Hence, “**Conclusions I, II and III follow.** ”.

questions.question:
Which two numbers (NOT digits) should be interchanged to make the following equation mathematically correct?

8 ÷ 2 × 6 - 11 + 5 = 15
questions.solution: __BODMAS RULE:__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/337cba09b098a129c60c88ca431dc00f7470bb1b39c1452e8d81688a7d6b6b0e.png] Option 1) : 2 and 8 Given equation: 8 ÷ 2 × 6 - 11 + 5 = 15 By interchanging 2 and 8 in the given equation. Interchanged equation is : __**2 ÷ 8**__ × 6 - 11 + 5 = 15 ⇒ __**0.25 × 6**__ - 11 + 5 = 15 ⇒ __**1.5**__ - 11 __**+ 5**__ = 15 ⇒ 6.5 - 11 = 15 ⇒ -4.5 ≠ 15 ⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

questions.question:
What will be the value of the following expression, if '+' and '×' are interchanged and '-' and '÷' are interchanged?

9 + 2 ÷ 5 × 4 - 2 = ?
questions.solution:
**BODMAS Rule:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94a3ba98fe537b71a0cedca8cdf679aea0668b950fa8b6ddc2ea6c6e99a6adff.png] 

If '+' and '×' are interchanged and '-' and '÷' are interchanged, we get:

⇒ 9 × 2 - 5 + __**4 ÷ 2**__

⇒ __**9 × 2**__ - 5 + 2 

⇒ __**18**__ - 5 __**+ 2**__ 

⇒ __**20 - 5**__ 

⇒ **15**

So the value of '**?**' is **15**.

Hence, **'option 4'** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
The ages of seven colleagues are compared. Pawan is older than only Lalit and Kunal. Jatin is the oldest. Manish is younger than only Jatin. Nilesh and Ojha are older than Pawan.

Who is the third youngest colleague?
questions.solution:
**Colleagues : **Pawan, Lalit, Kunal, Jatin, Manish, Nilesh and Ojha.

1) Jatin is the oldest. Manish is younger than only Jatin.

Jatin > Manish > _ > _ > _ > _ > _

2) Pawan is older than only Lalit and Kunal.

Jatin > Manish > _ > _ > Pawan > Lalit/Kunal > Lalit/Kunal

3) Nilesh and Ojha are older than Pawan.

**Jatin > Manish > Nilesh/Ojha > Nilesh/Ojha > Pawan > Lalit/Kunal > Lalit/Kunal**

**Pawan** is the third youngest colleague.

Hence, **'option 1'** is the correct answer.
